items.title: The Filmmakers at Wonder Dynamics Building AI for Filmmakers
items.excerpt: Wonder Dynamics co-founders Tye Sheridan and Nikola Todorovic discuss how their filmmaking backgrounds shaped Autodesk Flow Studio, an AI tool that transfers live-action performances onto CG characters while keeping artists in control and staying compatible with established VFX pipelines. A grounded look at AI-assisted performance-to-CG as a craft workflow, not a replacement.

items.title: Vida Scene Search: AI Scene-Level Search With No Manual Logging Required
items.excerpt: Vida launched Scene Search, an offline AI-powered indexing tool inside Vida Content OS that lets editors and post teams search a video library at the scene level using natural language, with no manually logged metadata. A concrete craft shift for how film and TV post finds and reuses footage.

items.title: Why we chose it: Estonia's FrostFX on using AI as another creative tool in post
items.excerpt: Estonian VFX studio FrostFX details a post pipeline that treats AI not as a replacement for artists but as a tool that removes repetitive technical work so artists spend more time on creative decisions. A grounded studio-level view of how an AI-assisted VFX workflow actually shifts the craft.

items.title: NVIDIA tackles deepfakes and opens the door to AI agents at SIGGRAPH 2026
items.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026 NVIDIA unveiled a synthetic-video detector to help newsrooms and VFX teams flag AI-generated footage, while showing how creative tools are opening to AI agents via Model Context Protocol. A concrete look at AI moving into both the authentication and the driving of creative pipelines.

items.title: HP Z Captis + Adobe Substance 3D: Digital Twin Capture Built for Scale
items.excerpt: HP and Adobe updated the HP Z Captis capture system with faster speeds and deeper Adobe Substance 3D Sampler integration, running hybrid AI inference on NVIDIA Jetson AGX to build production-ready digital twins for VFX and virtual production. A look at how AI-accelerated asset capture feeds the film pipeline.

items.title: Is this the future of filmmaking?
items.excerpt: Damian Allen walks through a hybrid AI film-set approach built on Beeble's SwitchLight, where AI transforms backgrounds and relighting while real actor performances and camera work are preserved. A hands-on read on the middle ground between traditional production and fully synthetic generation. (May overlap the already-carded Beeble SwitchLight hybrid-set item -- dedup.)
